verdict.rationale: Ellis Porter is an immigration law firm with a client portal for uploading documents, communicating, and tracking case status. A portal like this could plausibly offer AI-generated insights, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows only human attorney guidance and strategy recommendations, not AI-generated insights or suggestions from user data inside the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
